known_false_positives.description: The added benchmark command for the AI-MO/aimo-validation-aime dataset includes an unnecessary `--hf-split train` argument that should be removed.
AIMODataset does not require dataset subsets; set `common_kwargs['dataset_subset']` to None instead of `args.hf_subset` to prevent potential errors from passing unnecessary arguments.
